headline: Turkish Treasury Posts 329.9 Billion TL Cash Deficit in October
summary: Turkey's Treasury recorded a cash deficit of 329.9 billion lira in October, with cash revenues reaching 1.391 trillion lira and expenditures totaling 1.721 trillion lira.
why: Treasury cash balance reports provide essential data on central government fiscal discipline, public expenditure trends, and sovereign borrowing needs.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: A widening cash deficit indicates rising public sector financing requirements.
